newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oman cuts April crude price by $1.57/bbl--traders.
newsitem.headline: Oman cuts April crude price by $1.57/bbl--traders.

text.p: Oman cut the price of its crude oil for April lifting by $1.57 per barrel to $17.53 from the March price of $19.10, oil traders said on Tuesday.
With the April price set at $17.53, the difference between Oman and Dubai crude was around 90 cents, compared with $1.00 for March, traders said.
In March, Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals (MPM) set the price at $19.10. All prices are on a free-on-board basis.
Oman is a major non-OPEC oil producer which fixes the official selling price of its crude each month on a retroactive basis.
